node.label: alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase deficiency type 2
node.definition: Alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA) deficiency type 2 is a very rare mild adult type of NAGA deficiency with the features of angiokeratoma corporis diffusum and mild sensory neuropathy.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
